about_the_game:
Loop Mayor is a casual simulation building game where a mayor will collect taxes in a city with only one road. You need to use the connections between different buildings to arrange them reasonably, and strive to increase the value of the roads in the mayor's actions one after another, ultimately achieving the maximum value of the entire city
Mayor: Three different mayors have different abilities
Architectural association: Different buildings influence each other, for example, shopping centers increase their value due to the surrounding residential buildings, and also transmit their own value to residential buildings. 60+building types
Resident tasks: As the game progresses, residents need you to meet their various requirements, such as donating or building designated buildings in designated locations
Architectural function: Some buildings have unique functions, such as using sawmills to eliminate natural buildings on the map, such as forests
The game is the initial version, and subsequent content (more maps, buildings, features, etc.) will be continuously updated
